mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO review_commit_fact ( project_id, commit_sha, commit_time, author_name, author_email, message_first_line, source_event_id, create_time ) VALUES ( #{projectId}, #{commitSha}, #{commitTime}, #{authorName}, #{authorEmail}, #{messageFirstLine}, #{sourceEventId}, SYSDATE() )

INSERT IGNORE INTO review_commit_fact ( project_id, commit_sha, commit_time, author_name, author_email, message_first_line, source_event_id, create_time ) VALUES
(#{item.projectId}, #{item.commitSha}, #{item.commitTime}, #{item.authorName}, #{item.authorEmail}, #{item.messageFirstLine}, #{item.sourceEventId}, SYSDATE())
mapper.select: SELECT DATE(commit_time) AS stat_date, CASE WHEN author_email IS NOT NULL AND author_email != '' THEN LOWER(TRIM(author_email)) ELSE TRIM(author_name) END AS author_key, MAX(author_name) AS author_name, COUNT(1) AS commit_count FROM review_commit_fact WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND commit_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE(commit_time) >= #{beginDate} AND DATE(commit_time) <= #{endDate} AND ( (author_email IS NOT NULL AND author_email != '') OR (author_name IS NOT NULL AND author_name != '') ) GROUP BY DATE(commit_time), CASE WHEN author_email IS NOT NULL AND author_email != '' THEN LOWER(TRIM(author_email)) ELSE TRIM(author_name) END

SELECT author_email, author_name, MAX(commit_time) AS commit_time, MAX(id) AS id, MAX(project_id) AS project_id, MAX(commit_sha) AS commit_sha, MAX(message_first_line) AS message_first_line, MAX(source_event_id) AS source_event_id, MAX(create_time) AS create_time FROM review_commit_fact
( LOWER(author_email) = LOWER(#{email}) OR author_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userName}, '%') OR author_email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userName}, '%') )
